reviews.comment: Started in-person, but switched online halfway through. There are "participation assignments" but she gave everyone 100s, regardless if they actually did it. Also, we had a final term paper that she gave everyone a 100 on. She's nice and obviously cares about the subject but for whatever reason, didn't have the time to actually grade anything.
Ripped apart my paper because I supposadly did the wrong formating. Nitpicky professer who will remove points for putting the wrong date in header

She is a passionate professor but she is not tech-savvy. No grades have been posted online, NOT ONE! Assignments are turned in via email. Takes a while to get grades back to you. She rambles in her lectures which can become boring. If you want an easy class to pass take it because she is caring and very nice. It is just stressful at times.

Dr. Wollock is very passionate about what she does and she is a very caring professor! She grades very leniently - as long as she sees your effort and that you have some idea of what you're talking about, you'll do fine! She's also always there to help you when you need it! Class has a midterm, paper, and (usually) optional final!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: great professor but confusing on the line of which she is rambling or actually talking about the material.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is such a kind soul. She really cares about her students succeeding and she is very accommodating.

Dr. Wollock is a very nice person, and very knowledgable. However, her presentation of class material is not good. She rambles the whole class period, and gets off topic. There are only four grades for the semester, so it's stressful to prepare for the two tests that account for almost your whole grade. She's so nice, I wish she were better!

She could get a bit off topic, but I thought her lectures were always interesting and full of information. Her passion for the material is evident and I appreciated that. To succeed, showing up to class and doing the readings (lots of SparkNotes & Schmoop a must) is important. She is a very kind professor and I would take a class from her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr Wollock was fantastic. She was very generous/fair. Her lectures were extremely intellectual, filled with enormous amounts of information. I really loved going to class and taking notes, because of how fascinating her dialogue was. Anyone who is interested in history, mythology, Christianity, or the Bible itself, should really enjoy this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I enjoyed her class! I learned things that I didn't know before. She was actually late by a few minutes, not ten. As long as you go to lecture and read the suggested reading you will do fine. The class was really large, so its understandable why the test took long. You do have to memorize quotes, but she says them in class if you pay attention.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Wollock is a very nice lady. Bible Lit is a super simple class (i am very religious so most of the material I knew tons about-- sometimes more than she) but lectures are slow and boring. The exams are all writing free response, with an essay so they can be difficult to finish on time, but they aren't hard if you know your Bible. Overall, not bad
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Wollock is very disorganized and continually shows up to class ten minutes late every single time (including on test days, shortening your time). It has taken her over a month to return the first test and only returns it until about a week before your second test, not giving you proper time to correct the way you studied.

Took Prof Wollock for Bible Lit. Boring lectures, but nice woman. No quizzes or homework except reading Bible. Only grades were midterm and big paper at the end of semester (8-10 page essay of your choice). Final was optional.

Super unorganized. Does not even use ecampus so that is a red flag. With that being said, class is three tests and they are not that hard but I would not take her just because it takes a month and a half to get one test grade back. She is not worth the trouble when there are better classes out there with more structure. Most disorganized class ever
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Wollock is a super sweet woman but she's very disorganized. If you're someone who likes structure, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. It was just her talking vaguely about topics and then getting distracted and talking about something unrelated to class. We wrote 3 essays and I never got grades for any of them, but my final grade was an A.

Idk how she is every semester but, she has shown up late every class and has not had a set lecture. I haven't learned an ounce of anything. I feel like this class has been a joke. We had a midterm and wrote textual analysis papers and haven't received this grades back. Maybe she is just busy this semester. She is so kind but she's not focused.
